caption: The drawing depicts a single, pale green or light blue dress, centered on a plain, off-white background. The dress features short puffed sleeves with lace trim and a v-shaped collar made of an overlapping, sheer, white material. The bodice is fitted, and the skirt is wide and full. At the bottom of the dress, stretching upwards, is an ornate pattern of embroidered flowers and foliage in various colors, including shades of red, pink, blue, yellow, orange, and green. The floral motifs are densely packed along the lower hem and gradually become sparser higher up on the skirt, with a few flowers and stems depicted on the sleeves. The composition is focused solely on the dress, with no additional objects or background details present.
title: Dress
